supporting_observations.claim: At 13:43 UTC, sara.ali created the alerted account ext.rwong on the domain controller.
The account was added to the Contractors group shortly after creation by sara.ali.
The account name, creator, and Contractors-group assignment match the stated help-desk practice for temporary accounts, supporting a benign disposition.
The account-management events use sara.ali's logon ID, which had authenticated to the domain controller from WS-SALI-01 shortly beforehand.

known_telemetry_limitations: The records show creation and a Contractors-group addition, but do not provide a complete snapshot of the account's group memberships or effective privileges.
The logs do not establish whether a specific request or approval authorized this temporary account.
claims_not_established: Whether ext.rwong was created in response to a legitimate request.
Whether ext.rwong received any additional group memberships or privileges outside the events shown.
Whether the account was subsequently used, or whether sara.ali's session was compromised.
unrelated_findings: sara.ali launched Remote Desktop to FILE-COP-01 and established a remote interactive logon there. This is outside the alerted account-creation activity and may merit separate review against the organization's remote-administration practice. Records: T108-00013, T108-00019, T108-00020.
